________________________________________________________________________________
CYBERA - Release 1.9.rc2 change log
________________________________________________________________________________
Cybera Server:

20060220 cybera-server_1.9.rc2.exe
New functionality:
- Added prepaid Self service session mode: the manager directly recharges a 
  workstation with a given recharge. The session works exactly like a client 
  or card session except that remaining prepaid time cannot be kept.
- Enhanced workstation list info: tooltips now show remaining time/amount due 
  and session type.
- Added better recharge typing: You can now specify which session type a given
  recharge is for (Card, Client, Prepaid self service, Postpaid self service).
- Added finer recharge validity settings: you can now set the validity from 1 to
  30 days, weeks, months, years.
- Changed currency formatting settings: the format now contains </currSymbol> 
  that is replaced by the given symbol, this enables formats that put the symbol
  before the amount such as the £.
- Added event logging levels, by default only important events used by stats
  will be added to the events table, it is possible to start Cybera Server with
  the following two command line switches: -e:v (verbose) and -e:a (even more
  verbose) in order to increase event logging detail. The default setting will 
  diminish the amount of data in the database and will speed up the stats.
- Added an "Unlimited" flag to recharges. Unlimited recharges enable one to 
  provide Cards and Client accounts (not self-service sessions)  with unlimited 
  usage for a given validity period (in days, weeks, months, years).
- Added ability to sort recharges in Options and in the recharge window by
  double-clicking a column heading.
- Added a new post-paid billing mode: Time based billing. In this mode an 
  ordered list of selected recharges is used as a base. The system is given a 
  base time increment and a minimum billed time and calculates the bill using 
  these two times and the list of selected recharges.
- Added a new post-paid billing mode: Simple sequential recharge billing. In 
  this mode Cybera applies all the post-paid recharges in order from shortest to
  longest time. Should the session run further that the longest recharge, the
  system continues to increment the bill by specified time increments using the
  last recharge time/price ratio. This is now the default post-paid billing mode 
  for new installations.
- Added post-paid grace period. The admin can specify a grace period which will
  enable managers to cancel ended post-paid sessions without collecting payment
  if the session time is smaller that the specified grace period.
- Optimized card and client list update code: now only modified cards/clients 
  are updated in the GUI. This will speed up the GUI when one has over 2000
  elements in the cards or clients lists
- Added two new user rights: Card creation and client creation. This enables one
  to create users that cannot add customers but can only manage existing 
  customers.
- Changed the way database upgrading works: Cybera now upgrades a copy of the DB
  and only deletes the old version if the upgrade process works fine.
- Added ability to define the default usage mode (client/card/prepaid).
- Added button to generate a random number for the client login in the 
  "New Client" form so that one can use cybera clients like password protected 
  Cybera Cards.
- Extended Client comment to 255 characters and enabled multi-line comments.
  
Bug fixes:
- Fixed bug in workstation view, the displayed elapsed time was the workstation
  usage time, this was misleading, now it is the true elapsed time (without
  including paused time etc). The workstation usage time is displayed as a 
  tooltip.
- Fixed GUI bug in Workstation view in the dropdown menu.
- Fixed GUI bug that could crash the server on form resize (detected under w2k).
- Fixed GUI bug: the workstation control buttons where not contextualised to the
  current customer type.
- Fixed tabstop GUI bugs in Options, user config.
- Fixed bug in Stats: Internet connection time calculation was off (as well as 
  other stats).
- Fixed bug in Stats: Session graphs may not have been filled under certain
  conditions.
- Fixed bug in About box when it was left displayed for over 56 minutes.
- Fixed bug in user admin: if no users exist the delete & modify buttons where
  still active.
- Fixed GUI bug in Workstation view: If the same workstation had been connected
  under different credentials (Mac address, NETBIOS name etc) then it was 
  present multiple times in the workstation list.
- Fixed spelling mistakes in the English and French versions.
- Command line swiches are now case insensitive and can be prefixed with '/' or
  '-' (ex: /T -k)
- Fixed bug in session updating for free sessions: previous selfservice sessions
  where also updated.

20051020 cybera-server_1.9.rc1.exe
New functionality:
- Changed client login max lengh to 255 caracters.
- Changed off peak functonality: Now if you set:
  * Before_time > After_time then off peak is between those two times.
  * Before_time < After_time then off peak is from 00:00:00 to 
    before_time and from After_time to 23:59:59.
- Added a small form to the database upgrade procedure.
- Integrated Hungarian translation.
- Added the ability to release user rights when logged in as admin (in the menus
  only).

Bug fixes:
- Fixed bug in client view: the delete command on the dropdown menu on the right
  of the modify button did not do anything.
- Fixed bug on startup when no default printer is found (repoted by João 
  Brázio).
- Fixed yet another bug in the Console: the next session time was not correct 
  (well, it was but warped if time ratio % activated - sorry João).
- Fixed bug in client recharge process: the recharge label was not added to the
  income entry if the bonus system was deactivated.
- Fixed bug in stats printout: the table ColAlignments was not correct.
- Fixed GUI bug: Status panel image incorrect on shutdown.
- Fixed bug in follow mode: if the network transfer was slow between the server
  and a workstation, the server could loose control over the workstation.
- Made modifications to session stats calculations to speed them up.
- Fixed several bugs in the installer/uninstaller.
- Fixed bug in Options form errors could occur when no recharges or services
  where defined.
- Fixed a bug in server init that could give GUI bugs in certain conditions.
- Fixed GUI bug: the Chat warning status message was not correctly implemented.


20050915 cybera-server_1.9.b3.exe
New functionality:
- Integrated Brazilian Portuguese translation.
- Changed the user login (manager) to max 255 characters.
- Minor GUI inhancement in Card view (pending cards controls).
- Added Chat system between Server and workstations (FR #1179262).
- Added basic export capability to the History form: a new button (or Ctrl+C 
  will copy the card/client's selected data to the clipborard as a tab delimited
  table.
- Added ability to print Stats and History output to the default System printer.
- Added ability to specify the default workstation mode (connected or
  disconnected).

  Bug fixes:
- Fixed bug that prevented mass creation of pending cards without owner or type.
- Card type and owner where not memorised in the mass card creation form.
- Fixed small bug in session journals view when the logged in user did not have
  the journals user rights, certain controls where not disabled
- Fixed user rights bug: even is a user did not have the right to unblock a
  workstation, he/she could do so by right clicking on the workstations in the
  workstation view (reported by João Brázio).
- Fixed bug in Console update: the next session end was incorrectly calculated
  if both client and card sessions are running (reported by João Brázio).
- Fixed bug in recharge process: the recharge label was not added to the income
  entry if the bonus system was deactivated.
- Fixed bug in Workstation GUI, the status icon was sometimes not displayed
  properly.
- Fixed bug when workstation is rebooted during a self-service session: the 
  session was never paid. Now the workstation comes back up blocked as if the
  user had stopped his session and Cybera waits for payment before releasing the
  workstation.
- Enabled time ratios to be zero, thus making disconnected mode & off peak free.

20050806 cybera-server_1.9.b2.exe
New functionality:
- Added System tray icon and ability to hide the server window (minimize to 
  tray). The current user will be logged out after 5 minutes in this mode 
  (FR #1185787).
- Added Mass card creation system (FR #1179260):
  It is possible to mass create cards either directly enabled (ready to use) or
  in a pending state that needs to be enabled in order to be used. In this
  configuration, the Cards view of the server window will show the pending cards
  in a seperate list at the bottom of the form. It is possible to output the 
  generated card numbers to a simple text file or using a template HTML file
  containing </crdNumber> tags.
- Added the ability to chose the session stats output (FR #1167767).

Bug fixes:
- Fixed bug in Workstation Boot (WOL command) when the workstations do not
  provide a correct MAC addess.
- Fixed bug in Options form when displaying and selecting the network interface
  to bind to.
- Fixed bug (reported by Ynigo Geniza): If client name has letters in it, then
  that user can log in to different machines at the same time by changing the
  caps.
- Fixed bug in Login form that made all passwords lowercase. Upercase passwords
  did not work (BUG #1242256).

20050605 cybera-server_1.9.b1.exe
New functionality:
- Integrated Greek, German and Italian translations
- Transfered default workstation language selection from Client to server
  options
- Changed msg and logo update feature: if not activated on server, laguage
  selection on workstation changes the displayed rtf file

Bug fixes:
- Fixed bug in File menu when switching languages
- Fixed GUI for up-comming translations
- Fixed big bug in GUI update that stopped Cybea working with more than 20
  clients (reported by bsp98ht)
- Fixed small GUI bug in workstation popup menu positioning when the
  workstations have been scrolled (reported by bsp98ht)
- Fixed bugs in Setup Wizard (max clients now 50 & bug in default recharge
  creation)
- Fixed bug in MAC address detection in a multi network adapter environment

Bug fixes:

20050331 cybera-server_1.8.rc2.exe
New functionality:

  so that computers with several adapters can select the correct local network
  adapter
- Added ability to display workstations in two cols (compact view) for cyber
  cafes that have a lot of computers

Bug fixes:
- Fixed bug in client history: recharges could not be deleted
- Fixed bug in Workstation lockdown: The classic menu MUST be used on the
  workstations under Windows XP if you want to forbid Logoff. This seems to be a
  Microsoft bug The server now forces the use of the standard menu
- Set max workstations to 50
- Fixed small GUI bugs

20050320 cybera-server_1.8.rc1.exe
New functionality:

  field to the recharge form)
- Added ability to enable / disable credit expiry for clients
- Added session start & end batch files on the workstations
- Added GUI inhancement (input help tooltips)
- Added GUI inhancement (Greyed cards & clients in lists if disabled)

Bug fixes:
- Fixed bug in worksation data processing (data from different workstations
  could get mixed up)
- Fixed small GUI bug in Services view

Bug fixes:

- Fixed bug in client management that prevented client usage
- Fixed bugs on card or client recharge when the customer has no more credit
- Fixed bug on session resume when the customer has no more credit
- Fixed bug in console update: clients where not taken into account
- Fixed small GUI bugs (tabstops etc)

20050303 cybera-server_1.7.28.exe
New functionality:
- Added "Clients": prepaid user accounts with a login and a password
- Added "Shutdown unused workstations" in Workstation shutdown form
- Added Workstation Boot selection form and context menu items
- The workstation view now shows all previously connected computers

Bug fixes:
- Fixed possible bug in new card creation
- Fixed a bug when the computer is set up to use 12h clock that prevented
  setting recharges of more that 12h (I hate "Locale" PBs!)
- Fixed a bug in card & client recharge where the label was incorrect when using
  12h clock in regional settings 
- Fixed other 12h clock bugs... (Again, I hate "Locale" PBs!)
- Fixed bug in bonus threshold calculation during recharge when using currencies
  that use decimals
- Fixed small gui bugs
- Fixed bug in session resume when client and server clocks are not in sync
- Fixed bug in session resume: used time credit is now deduced from remaining
  time credit instead of replacing time credit
- Fixed bug in DB backup that could delete old backups without replacing them.

20050217 cybera-server_1.6.47.exe
New functionality:
- Added automatic Client - Server connection (client finds a server to connect
  to)
- Added Cybera User management & user rights on server (employees). This also
  enables Income and sessions to be attributed to a given user
- Added ability to Enable/Disable Session Pause on clients
- URLspy: added ability to automatically purge URLs as the DB will grow too fast
  without automatic limiting
- Added info on where the last network backup is to the DB maintenance form
- Added warnings when DB size grows past 30MB, 60MB and 120MB
- Added a configuration wizard to help installing and setting up Cybera
- DB purge: added option to include/exclude accounting data from purge
- Added Popup menus to clients in Client view and to card list in card view
- Added Wake on LAN capablilty: the server can boot the last client workstations
  who where connected to the server

Bug fixes:
- Better main window resize management
- More robust session stats compilation (better recovery from app crash and
  corrupt EVENT entries in DB)
- Fixed big bug in app shutdown introduced in rel1.5
- Fixed possible bug in session open code that corrupted the events DB table
  entries
- Diminished console update overhead
- Fixed possible bug in income journal
- Fixed small bug in Options page (some params did not trigger modification
  detection)
- Fixed bug in client view: crd history button was invisible when credit runs
  out
- Fixed small bug in Stats, session list averages where incorrect
- Fixed small bug in card view when positioning card list after seaching for a
  card.
- Changed the default values for many server settings in order to make Cybera
  easier to install and use
- Fixed bug in DB purge
- Fixed bug on certain buttons where an accidental doubleclick triggered
  unpredictable events
- Fixed bug in DB maintanace: on DB restore selection, the latest version was
  restored regardless of the selection
- Fixed bug in DB restore: if DB passwd was different restore failed
- Fixed gui bug in journals where boubleclick on filters was possible during a
  stat computation
- Enhanced recharge config form in options
- Fixed bug in Uninstall: reg keys where not deleted
- Added a 2 sec timer before activating server-client connectivity in order to
  let Server startup before dealing with client requests
- GUI: Enhanced client selection responsiveness in client view
- Fixed bug that could render resumed sessions unstable (after server restart)
- Fixed bug in stats: session resume after server restat was not detected
  properly
- Fixed possible bug in card history when the same card number has existed more
  than once
- Fixed minor GUI bug in stats progress bar

20041230 cybera-server_1.5.46.exe
New functionality:
- Intergrated (almost) all client and session settings into the server
- Client sessions no longer are closed when client-server connection is cut.
  The server is updated as soon as connection is restored
- changed default setting for selfservice mode: now off
- Added ability to hide card numbers on client (like passwords)
- Added ability to activate/deactivate cards
- Added client Internet explorter URL logging ability
- Added DB backup to client workstations for extra security
- Externalized language resources as dlls (easier translations)
- Added ability to automatically upgrade the database when needed
- Added ability to restore the database from one of the backups
- Added ability to modify maximum number of database backups in the registry 
  (delault 4, max 20) Key: "HKLM\Software\Cybera Server\DB\Max Backups"
- Added ability to empty IM profiles in session cleanup (GAIM only for now)
- GUI touch ups (use of system fonts among other things)

Bug fixes:
- Fixed missing default cyber cafe logo in installer package
- incorrect error management on 'no file found' when attempting to preview
  message & logo files
- Fixed bug in stats: incorrect internet connection time on current date
- Moved DB backup from app startup to app shutdown and then only if the database
  was correctly opend and closed.
- speeded up database management at shutdown

Bug fixes:

- Fixed small GUI update bug in card view
- Fixed bug in card recharge when client attempts a connection at exactly the
  same time.

________________________________________________________________________________
Cybera Workstation:

20060220 cybera-client_1.9.rc2.exe
New functionality:
- Added two new command line swiches:
  -s : this hides all status windows while a session is running
  -c : this disables all session close buttons so that the customer cannot close 
       a running session him/her self.

Bug fixes:
- Fixed GUI bug in blocked screen when cards are not enabled, the screen was not
  reset properly.
- Fixed bug in self-service mode, the displayed elapsed time was the workstation
  usage time, this was misleading, now it is the true elapsed time (without
  including paused time etc). The workstation usage time is displayed as a 
  tooltip.
- Fixed bug that enabled clicking on the system tray icon at start-up.
- Changed session end routine: for self-service sessions the end batch file is 
  now run after the customer has paid (once the collect button has been pressed 
  on the server).
- Fixed GUI bug in status forms in post-paid self-service mode.
- Fixed bug in About box when it was left displayed for over 56 minutes.
- Fixed spelling mistakes in the English and French versions.
- Fixed small focus bugs in message box.
- Command line swiches are now case insensitive and can be prefixed with '/' or
  '-' (ex: /T -k)
- Changed the time delay before activating a workstation after 3 unsuccessfull
  connection attempts form 5 to 2 minutes.

20051020 cybera-client_1.9.rc1.exe
New functionality:
- Integrated Hungarian translation.
- Changed client login max lengh to 255 caracters.
- Added -l command line argument, this completely disables user rights lockdown.

Bug fixes:
- Fixed bug when session is started from server: the session was always
  connected, the default mode was not used.
- fixed bug in status form, the set password and chat buttons where not disabled
  properly when the server connection is down.
- Fixed bug in disconnected mode: some forms of IE where not detected correctly.
  If a website was called from within an explorer.exe process, Cybera did not 
  detect and close the explorer window (found by Biba Nadjoari and the Cyber
  users in Fada N'Gourma, Burkina Faso).
- Fixed bug found by Luigi Lumento in workstation startup: in XP some fast
  computers can have problems with accessing GUI resources too soon - added a
  delay (in seconds) to the application startup that is configurable (30 seconds
  from boot by default) in:
  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Cybera Client\General" value "Start Delay" (in seconds)
- Fixed bug in follow mode: if the network transfer was slow between the server
  and a workstation, the server could loose control over the workstation.
- Fixed bug in Free session resume (from pause, lock or follow): the Stop button
  was no longer displayed.
- Fixed bug in blocked form that prevented a client from entring his password
  if he had had a previous incorrect login (found by Daniel Bernal).
- Fixed bug that stopped screensavers from working when the screen is blocked.
- Fixed several bugs in the installer/uninstaller.
- Fixed big bug in workstation deactivation: if server operator was admin then
  the workstation could be deactivated with a blank password.
- Changed the way session start and stop batch files are run: in self service
  mode, the %1 parameter is now the workstation computer name.
- Fixed bug when only Selfservice mode in enabled: the Activate button of the 
  blocked screen was not enabled on session close.
- Fixed bug in Blocked screen when Cyber Cards are disabled and Clients are 
  enabled: the Login text input did not have focus by default.
  
20050915 cybera-client_1.9.b3.exe
New functionality:
- Integrated Brazilian Portuguese translation.
- Changed the user login (manager) to max 255 characters.
- Added Chat system between Server and workstations (FR #1179262).
- Added ability to specify the default workstation mode (connected or
  disconnected).
- Changed off peak functonality: Now if you set:
  + Before_time > After_time then off peak is between those two times
  + Before_time < After_time then off peak is from 00:00:00 to 
    before_time and from After_time to 23:59:59

Bug fixes:
- Stripped down and repackaged Windows locking DLL for Cybera due to Antivir
  detecting WinLockDLL as a virus.
- Fixed bug that stopped the Follow mode from starting correctly.
- Fixed bug in blocked form that made language selection impossible with the
  mouse (reported by João Brázio).
- Fixed bug when workstation is rebooted during a self-service session: the
  session was never payed. Now the workstation comes back up blocked as if the
  user had stopped his session and Cybera waits for payment before releasing the
  workstation.
- Enabled time ratios to be zero, thus making disconnected mode & off peak free.

20050806 cybera-client_1.9.b2.exe
New functionality:
- Added a 2 minute timeout when the client gets locked due to 3 invalid logins /
  card numbers. The clients become active after this time
- Added compatibility with Terminal server and diskless workstations
- Removed Cybera from taskbar in small status mode. Added ability to hide/show
  status window on doubleclick on the System tray icon (FR #1185787).
- Added the ability for the manager logged in to the server to deactivate Cybera
  client with his own login & password if he has the right to unblock the
  workstations. otherwise the admin password is required. The admin password is
  still required in order to quit Cybera client but no longer in order to
  logoff, reboot or shutdown the computer (FR #1239603).
- Added delete complete IE cache (all files & cookies) and history to IE
  clean-up routine before each session start (if requested in server options).

Bug fixes:
- Fixed bug in blocked form when Self service was selected: the Activate button
  was not always enabled (reported by izopizo).
- Fixed small GUI bug in small status form.
- Fixed bug in time accounting when the workstation system time is changed
  during a customer session.
- Fixed bug (reported by Ynigo Geniza): If client name has letters in it, then
  that user can log in to different machines at the same time by changing the
  caps.

- At last fixed an obscure bug in file transfers from server to client where the
  last chunk of jpgs was corrupted (in follow mode for example). This was due to
  4 unexplained bytes being added to the file when using the LEFT function
  directly in a PUT statement
- Fixed bug that could render resumed sessions unstable (after server restart)
- Fixed bug on file reception that could bring down the Client-Server connection

New functionality:
- Intergrated (almost) all client and session settings into the server

  The server is updated as soon as connection is restored

- Enhanced file transfer between server and client (faster reception)
- Optimized Client -> Server communication (less network trafic)
- Fixed bug blocking client when an internall error happened in blocked mode
- Fixed bug that would sometimes put the client in 'Blocked - Session end' mode
  when no self-service session had ended
